<function name="Translate" parent="VMatrix" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Translates the matrix by the given vector aka. adds the vector to the translation.

Postmultiplies the matrix by a translation matrix (A = AT).
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="translation" type="Vector">Vector to translate the matrix by.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
